int_name: N 20TH ST & W HUNTING PARK AVE

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks and curb ramps adjacent to a health center. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of wide curb radii may compromise safety by increasing crossing exposure and vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and uneven surfaces within the crosswalk area can pose a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, within the crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk area to eliminate trip hazards and improve visibility of markings.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, safety is compromised by long crossing distances without a refuge and sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb near the intersection block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right-hand curb line leading up to the intersection.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area may present a minor tripping hazard or reduce the visibility of markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, within the marked crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching motorists.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide asphalt intersection with faded crosswalk markings and minimal traffic control. While sidewalks are present, the large expanse of open roadway and lack of vertical separation or refuge islands increases pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground crossing the side street

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals within a mixed residential and commercial setting. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the blue awning building.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the zebra crosswalk across the main road.
